name: visual-case-binding
goal: Require strict visual cases to retain screenshot evidence bound to their exact case and retry

evidence: A passed visual test can satisfy the case gate with no case-bound screenshot or with a sibling case screenshot.
The existing validation case checks case outcomes and scenario declarations separately, but never binds screenshot bytes and retries to the referenced case.
Existing class validation case at 7c9c8a7d0d accepts a passed visual outcome without any case-bound screenshot.
